name: Wohelo Camps
description_short: Wohelo is an overnight camp for girls in Raymond, Maine, run as two camps: Little Wohelo (ages 6-12) and Sebago Wohelo (ages 12-15). The camp prefers the full seven-week season. It also offers half sessions for first-time campers and a one-week Peep Week.

sources.note: Dates and tuition page: 2027 dates and tuition, Little Wohelo 6-12 and Sebago Wohelo 12-15, year-round office address; half sessions introduce girls to camping
Campership page: apply with the Wohelo Scholarship Application and a tax statement

source.title: Dates and Tuition - Wohelo Camps Website

warnings: Address given is the 'Year-round office'. The camp itself is presumed to be at or near this address in Raymond, ME, but the page does not say so.
The page does not state which age groups or which camp (Little or Sebago Wohelo) each session is for, especially Peep Week.
Financial aid is inferred from the 'Scholarship Information' and 'Apply for a Wohelo Campership' navigation links. The terms are not on this page.
The camp encourages the full season. It says half sessions are only a one-summer introduction for new campers.
New registrations are by contacting the camp office directly.
